name: Widow's Receipt Stub
description: Proof that someone's soul was held in storage. The widow kept it. The Tithe never asked for it back, which is unusual.
shiftEffect: Shifting into the Astral Plane costs 5 less Ki.

name: Baker's Second Loaf
description: A small stone loaf. The baker says he set it aside for later. Later turned out to be inconvenient. He wants it back, but you may borrow it.
shiftEffect: Shifting into the Astral Plane costs 3 less Ki.

name: Ferryman's Late Coin
description: A coin paid after the crossing instead of before. One side is warm, the other is not. The ferryman declines to say which is which.
shiftEffect: Your Astral Plane stay lasts 4 seconds longer before Ki drains.

name: Clerk's Stamped Pardon
description: A pardon, correctly stamped, for an offence nobody can name. It is valid in one plane and merely decorative in the other.
shiftEffect: Staying in the Astral Plane drains 1 less Ki per second.

name: Gravedigger's Folding Chair
description: A tiny carved chair, carried by a man who spent years standing between two worlds. He would like you to sit down.
shiftEffect: Ki recovers 25% faster while in the Material Plane.
